snippet.title: Instruments of Destruction V2   Secret Mode
snippet.description:
Get ready to wreak havoc like never before. Instruments of Destruction, the high-octane vehicle action game built around advanced physics-based destruction, is now live on console. Smash through walls, tear down buildings and send structures crashing into one another across over 130 unique vehicles and dozens of missions. The sandbox is yours to demolish.

Console edition (PS5 & Xbox Series) is available now. Jump in, ignite the chaos and build - then destroy - at your own pace.
